method: Per-square scatter of the region-A-referenced NISAR displacement history about a straight line (n - 2 degrees of freedom), from consecutive ramp-removed pairs; includes real non-linear motion, so it is an upper bound on noise.
limitations: The 22 pairs span about ten months, so seasonal ground motion is not separated from noise.
Ramp removal also removes any real motion that is planar across the frame.
Simple nearest-neighbour chain with no loop closures: unwrapping errors are not independently checked.
